Records whose ref starts with 'deep:' were added on 2026-10-29 for the P1 adoption (1.0.0-alpha.4): each was read at its pinned commit in the 2026-10-28 deep reads (shallow clones of the pinned repositories, read as data, nothing run), names the adoption items it supports, states its own licence status and grades each mechanism present or wired. Records whose ref starts with 'p2:' were added on 2026-10-29 for the P2 adoption (1.0.0-alpha.5): each was read at its pinned commit in the 2026-10-28 deep reads or the 2026-10-29 adjacent deep reads (shallow clones or fetched files, read as data, nothing run), names the adoption items it supports, states its own licence status and grades each mechanism present or wired. A restricted source is marked never to quote, and an X post is recorded from a third-party text copy with its original address. The policy above describes the earlier records; a p2: record says for itself how it was read. One more record (ap:, the Aura Autopilot addendum, 2026-10-30) was read at its pin by the addendum's author; the clone was not opened for this change, and the benchmark in the Aura post is the authors' claim, graded claimed.
